11 recommended medical slimming diet clinics in Nagoya! Compare by price, treatment, and area

 

"I'm looking for a medical slimming clinic in Nagoya, but I don't know which one to choose."

"There are so many types of treatments that it's hard to decide which one is right for you."

Many people may have the same problems as mentioned above.

There is a medical slimming clinic in Nagoya city.More than a dozen hospitalsThere is a wide range of treatments available, including fat cooling, GLP-1 injections, fat dissolving injections, EMS, and liposuction, making it difficult for those considering it for the first time to choose.

In this article, we will introduce recommended places in Nagoya.11 medical slimming clinicswill be compared on three axes: type of treatment, price, and area.

In addition, we will explain the criteria for choosing a clinic, the price range and side effects of each treatment, and points to check to prevent mistakes.

Doctor on-site, transparent pricing, easy-to-go locationBy comparing these three points, you can narrow down the clinic that suits you.

What you can learn from this article
  • Four criteria for choosing a medical slimming clinic in Nagoya (resident doctor, price, counseling, location)
  • 5 types of treatments available in Nagoya and unsuitable for them (fat cooling, GLP-1, fat dissolving injection, EMS, liposuction)
Supervisor of this article

Yoshitomo Chihara

Director of Norris Beauty Clinic

Postdoctoral Researcher, Norris Cancer Center, University of Southern California;National Cancer Center PathologyHead of the club,Nara Prefectural Medical UniversityLecturer in Molecular Pathology,Saiseikai Chuwa HospitalAfter serving as head of the urology departmentnorris beauty clinicOpened a hospital.

Norris Beauty Clinic’s content production policy regarding aesthetic medicine

Norris Beauty Clinic operates with the aim of disseminating accurate and easy-to-understand information to our readers about aesthetic medicine, such as medical diets (GLP-1 receptor agonists, fat freezing, fat-dissolving injections, liposuction, etc.) and double plastic surgery.

Cosmetic treatments such as medical diets and double plastic surgery are important themes that are closely related to each individual's health condition, constitution, cost, and schedule.

We create content with an emphasis on reliability, neutrality, and safety so that our readers can calmly make choices that are suitable for them and prepare for advance counseling.

■Basic policy for content production

■Production flow

At our media, we create content through the following process.

Production flow
  1. Search needs/concerns survey
  2. Configuration design (organizing comparison standards and points to note)
  3. Writing/editing/fact checking
  4. Regular updates to the latest prices and medical system

■Regarding reliability of information

When writing articles, we use the following public institutions and highly reliable information sources.

An example of reference data for this media
  • Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare(Medical advertising guidelines/Pharmaceuticals Act related information)
  • PMDA (Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency)
  • Japan Obesity Society・Japanese Society of Aesthetic Surgery (JSAS)Related academic societies such as
  • Consumer Affairs Agency(Related to the Specified Commercial Transactions Act and the Act on Premiums and Representations)
  • Official website information of each medical institution/pharmaceutical company

In addition, we regularly review information in response to price revisions, changes in clinic hours, updated guidelines, etc.

■Commitment to neutrality and transparency

Guaranteeing neutrality and objectivity
  • Specifies not only the benefits of each treatment but also side effects, risks, and downtime.
  • Presents points to note regarding total costs and cancellation regulations (cooling-off, etc.) for free medical treatment.
  • Do not use definitive expressions such as ``always'' or ``absolutely'' regarding changes or progress that vary from person to person.
  • Information is posted based on objective facts regardless of whether there is a partnership or not.

Four criteria you should know before choosing a medical slimming clinic in Nagoya

In order to avoid making mistakes when choosing a clinic, consider not only the price and location, but alsoReliability as a medical institutionIt is essential to check the suitability of the treatment.

Four criteria for choosing a clinic
  • Doctor presence and compliance with medical advertising guidelines determine clinic credibility
  • Understand hospital costs by paying attention to the difference between the total fee and the monthly fee.
  • An important decision point is whether or not the treatment is suitable for you through counseling.
  • Whether the area is easy to get to, such as Nagoya Station, Sakae, or Kanayama, also affects the retention rate.

In the current situation where there are dozens of clinics in Nagoya city, if you judge only by the appearance of the website or the low price, it is easy to end up with mismatches such as ``the effect was not what I expected'' or ``additional costs were incurred.''

When narrowing down your clinic,Whether or not there is a resident doctor, understanding the total fee, quality of counseling, and visiting areaBy comparing based on these four points, it will be easier to find a clinic that meets your goals.

Below, we will explain these four criteria in turn.

Doctor presence and compliance with medical advertising guidelines determine clinic credibility

When choosing a medical weight loss clinic, the first thing you should check isIs there a doctor on duty?It is.

In cases where the doctor is not involved in the treatment and the esthetician or staff is responsible for the treatment,Unqualified practice of medical practiceThis can make a big difference in how you respond if your physical condition changes during the treatment.

Clinics that provide careful treatment have a doctor on-site, and have a system in which everything from counseling to post-procedure follow-up is carried out under the doctor's supervision.

How to identify a reliable clinic
  • A doctor is always on-site to manage everything from counseling to post-operative follow-up.
  • There are no unfounded expressions such as “You will definitely lose weight” on the homepage.
  • Information disclosure complies with the Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare's medical advertising guidelines.
  • We have a system in place that allows doctors to respond immediately when your physical condition changes.

I would also like to check the following:medical advertising guidelinesCompliance with.

These guidelines were established by the Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare, and prohibit unfounded exaggeration of effects and unlimited publication of comparative advertisements and testimonials.

Q1-18 Are testimonials about the content or effects of treatments posted on websites where medical institutions can be searched subject to advertising regulations? (P.6,11)
A1-18 If testimonials from a specific medical institution are attracting, they will be subject to advertising regulations, and testimonials regarding the content or effects of treatment, etc. cannot be published.

Quote:Q&A regarding medical advertising guidelines | Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare

Clinics whose homepages feature unfounded expressions such as ``You will definitely lose weight'' and ``Reduction by ◯◯% compared to 〇〇'' tend to have low awareness of the guidelines.

Clinics that do not have a doctor on hand or that use exaggerated expressions that deviate from medical advertising guidelines may have insufficient safety management systems. Please check the wording on the homepage before your first consultation.

Before the effect of the treatment,Is there a system in place to safely undergo treatment?Please check.

Understand hospital costs by paying attention to the difference between the total fee and the monthly fee.

The price for medical weight loss is not the unit price per session,Compare the total amount required to achieve the goalThat is important.

For fat cooling, per area per session20,000 to 50,000 yenThe degree is the average price, but since multiple treatments are required on multiple areas, the total cost isOver 100,000 yenCases are not uncommon.

Many clinics offer monthly plans for GLP-1 injections.8,000 yen - 30,000 yenThere is a wide range of degrees, but it takes until the effect is seen.3-6 monthsIt is often necessary to estimate the total ongoing costs in advance.

Displays such as "first-time limited XX Yen" or "monitor price" may result in a significant increase in charges from the second time onward. At the time of your consultation, be sure to check the regular fees for the second and subsequent treatments and the recommended number of treatments to achieve your goals.

For monthly plans and pay-as-you-go plans, the total amount may be reversed depending on the number of continuations.

Please choose a plan after calculating which option will reduce the actual cost based on your own hospital visit pace.

An important decision point is whether or not the treatment is suitable for you through counseling.

In medical slimming, which has many types of treatments,Can you choose a treatment that suits your constitution and goals?How it works is directly related to the effect.

fat freezing issubcutaneous fatWhile it is highly suitable for areas with a lot of visceral fat, it is less effective for types with a lot of visceral fat, so it is best suited in combination with GLP-1 injections and dietary guidance.

EMS is a treatment that tightens the core using electrical stimulation of the muscles, so it is suitable for those who want to adjust the contours of their body shape rather than the amount of fat.

Lipolytic injection is a method of injecting a small amount of medicine to break down fat cells, which can reduce the appearance of double chins and abdominal areas.Partial thinningThis is a treatment often used for.

Quick reference chart for suitable and unsuitable treatments for each treatment
  • fat cooling: Suitable for slimming areas with a lot of subcutaneous fat such as the abdomen and thighs
  • GLP-1 injection: Suitable for people who have a lot of visceral fat and have difficulty controlling their appetite.
  • EMS: Suitable for those who value contouring and tightening of the body rather than fat.
  • fat dissolving injection: Suitable for slimming small areas such as double chin and abdomen

As each treatment is suitable and unsuitable, it is important to choose a clinic that proposes a treatment after the doctor or person in charge listens to your body shape, lifestyle, and goals during counseling.

Clinics that rush to sign a contract after counseling, or clinics that recommend the same treatment for all concerns, may have low quality individualized treatment.

Many clinics offer free counseling, soCompare 2 to 3 hospitalsThen decide whether to sign the contract or not.

Whether the area is easy to get to, such as Nagoya Station, Sakae, or Kanayama, also affects the retention rate.

Many medical slimming treatments require multiple hospital visits,Easy access to clinics has a direct impact on retention ratesI will.

The main clinic cluster areas in Nagoya city are:Around Nagoya Station/Sakae/KanayamaThere are 3 locations.

Characteristics of the three major clinic areas in Nagoya
  • Around Nagoya Station: Shinkansen, subway, Kintetsu, JR collection. All of Aichi prefecture + easy access from outside the city
  • Sakae area: The subway Higashiyama Line and Meijo Line intersect. Easy to visit the hospital during lunch break or while shopping
  • Kanayama: Transfer point for JR, Meitetsu, and subway. Suitable for hospital visits from the southern and eastern areas

The area around Nagoya Station is a terminal for Shinkansen, subway, Kintetsu, and JR lines, and is easily accessible from all over Aichi Prefecture, with many clinics located in locations that are easy to stop by on your way home from work.

The Sakae area is a downtown area where the Higashiyama and Meijo subway lines intersect, and is a popular location for visiting the hospital during your lunch break or while shopping.

Kanayama is located between Nagoya Station and Sakae, and is a transfer point for JR, Meitetsu, and subway lines, so it is an area suitable for people commuting to the hospital from the southern and eastern areas.

By choosing a clinic near your home or workplace, you will have less time between treatments, making it easier to achieve your goals.

Please check in advance whether the hospital route and clinic hours fit your schedule before booking your consultation.

5 types of medical slimming treatments available in Nagoya and which ones are not suitable for you

The treatments offered at Nagoya's medical slimming clinic are:fat cooling・GLP-1 injection・fat dissolving injection・EMS・liposuctionThe five types are the mainstream.

5 types of treatments, suitability, cost, and downtime
  • Fat cooling: Treatment suitable for people aiming to lose weight in areas such as the abdomen and thighs
  • GLP-1 injections: drug therapy aimed at suppressing appetite and overall weight loss
  • Lipolytic injections: an option for people who want to locally dissolve small amounts of fat
  • EMS: Treatment to strengthen and tighten inner muscles
  • Liposuction: A surgical procedure considered by those seeking significant fat reduction in one session.

Each treatment is different in terms of which areas it works on and what kind of change in body shape you can aim for, so if you choose a treatment that does not match your goals, it will be difficult to get the results you expected even if you spend money.

When comparing the 5 types,Presence of downtime, total cost, and period until results are seenIf you organize your treatment based on these three axes, it will be easier to narrow down the treatments that are suitable for you.

Fat cooling is a treatment suitable for people who aim to lose weight in areas such as the abdomen and thighs.

Fat freezing is a procedure in which a cooling device is applied over the skin to freeze fat cells and expel them from the body.

The surgical risk is low because a scalpel is not used, and the feature is that you can wait for the progress while living your daily life after the procedure.

This product is a device that reduces fat thickness by transcutaneously cooling the subcutaneous fat in the area where fat reduction is desired, and is used by connecting an applicator (manufacturing and sales notification product) that is attached to the treatment area.

Quote:Cool Sculpting｜PMDA

Because we approach areas where you are concerned about localized fat, such as the abdomen, thighs, upper arms, and flanks, one by one, we offer treatments for patients who only want to slim their stomach or reduce the outer bulge of their thighs.Request for partial thinningIt is suitable for

Until it takes effectApproximately 2 to 3 monthsApproximately one treatment will remove fat cells.20-25% reductionClinical data shows that

Basic data of fat freezing
  • Target area:Abdomen, thighs, upper arms, flanks, etc.
  • fat loss rate: Approximately 20-25% after one treatment (clinical data)
  • Effect expression:2 to 3 months after treatment
  • Nagoya market price:30,000 to 80,000 yen per part
  • Not suitable for people:Those with a lot of visceral fat/high BMI

Immediately after the treatment, you may experience some redness or temporary numbness, but in most cases this subsides within a few days to a few weeks.

On the other hand, it is less effective for people who want to significantly reduce their whole body weight or have a lot of visceral fat, so if your BMI is high, consult your doctor about combining it with GLP-1 injections or liposuction.

Fat freezing may rarely cause "induration", which is hardening of the treated area. If your symptoms persist, please contact your clinic immediately.

GLP-1 injection is a drug therapy aimed at suppressing appetite and overall weight loss

GLP-1 injection is a hormone secreted after mealsGLP-1This is a drug therapy that replenishes glucagon-like peptide-1 (glucagon-like peptide-1) from outside the body, suppressing appetite and slowing the rise in blood sugar levels.

It is not a treatment that directly melts fat,control your appetiteThis naturally reduces your calorie intake, leading to overall weight loss.

This treatment is suitable for people who can't keep up with dietary restrictions or who have a strong sense of hunger and can't stop snacking, and is likely to be effective when combined with lifestyle changes.

Administered as a once-weekly injection or daily oral medication, clinics in Nagoya city have administered the drug once per month.10,000 yen to 30,000 yenYou can see many pricing options.

Basic data of GLP-1 injection
  • How it works: Drug therapy that suppresses appetite and slows rise in blood sugar levels
  • Administration method: Once a week injection or daily oral administration
  • Nagoya market price:Monthly 10,000 yen to 30,000 yen
  • side effects: Nausea, constipation, diarrhea (prone to occur 1 to 2 weeks after starting treatment)
  • person for:Those who have difficulty controlling their appetite/those aiming for overall weight loss

Nausea, constipation, and diarrhea are likely to occur as side effects, especially immediately after starting administration.1-2 weekstend to have symptoms.

GLP-1 drugs are medicines that require a doctor's prescription. It is recommended that you take a medical history even if you prescribe online. Please refrain from changing the dose based on your own judgment.

The safety and effectiveness of GLP-1 receptor agonists, etc., when used off-label, rather than within the approved efficacy, dosage and administration range, has not been confirmed, and sufficient caution is required as it may lead to health damage due to unexpected adverse events.

Quote:Regarding the proper use of GLP-1 receptor agonists and GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonists | Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare

You may not be able to use this product depending on your pre-existing conditions or the medications you are currently taking, so be sure to accurately inform your medical history and medication history at the time of counseling.

Lipolytic injections are an option for people who want to locally dissolve small amounts of fat.

Lipolytic injection is a procedure in which a drug that breaks down fat cells is injected directly under the skin to locally reduce fat mass.

Under the chin, upper arms, inner thighs, etc.Small areas that are difficult to reach with fat cooling equipmentThe major difference from other treatments is that it can also be used.

The cost per treatment varies depending on the area and drug used, but in Nagoya city, the cost per treatment is per area.10,000 yen to 30,000 yenis considered to be the market price.

Main drugs and characteristics of fat-dissolving injections
  • BNLS: Contains plant-derived ingredients. It causes relatively little swelling and is often used on the face.
  • Kabel line: Contains deoxycholic acid. Has high lipolytic power and is easy to use on the abdomen and thighs
  • Common points: Effects accumulate after multiple treatments (3 to 5 times)
  • Nagoya market price: 10,000 to 30,000 yen per part per session

The effects accumulate by repeating multiple treatments, so it is suitable for those who want to improve their shape little by little, rather than those who are looking for a drastic change in one session.

After the injection, swelling, redness, and internal bleeding may occur at the treatment site, and there is no downtime.A few days to a weekIf you look at the above, you can expect safety-conscious responses.

The effects and side effects vary depending on the type of drug used (BNLS, Caverline, etc.), so be sure to confirm which drug to use during your consultation.

EMS trains and tightens inner muscles by electrically stimulating muscles.

EMS applies electrical muscle stimulation to muscles that are difficult to train through voluntary exercise.inner muscleThis is a treatment that shrinks the .

Rather than a treatment that directly reduces fat, we aim to create a toned physique by increasing muscle mass and increasing basal metabolism.

EMS provided by medical institutions has a higher output than equipment used in beauty salons, and can be used only once.About 30 minutesIt is said that it is possible to reproduce thousands of muscle contractions with this treatment.

People who are suitable for EMS and people who are not suitable for it
  • Suitable for those who aim to tighten their body shape and strengthen their inner muscles
  • Suitable for those who want to go to the hospital without downtime
  • Suitable for people who don't like exercise or are too busy to take time for exercise
  • Those who have a large amount of fat and want to significantly reduce weight: Difficult to see results alone (combination with other treatments recommended)
  • If you are wearing a pacemaker or pregnant: Cannot be used

What is paradoxical fat hyperplasia?

A rare side effect in which fat cells proliferate after fat freezing. If the affected area becomes hard and swollen 2 to 3 months after the treatment, do not leave it untreated and contact the treatment clinic immediately. It does not improve on its own and may require surgical treatment.
